description: A0 with exactly one change: core_math.balance_logits(strength=...) .30 -> .25

change.what: probability-level calibration: interpolation strength between the raw posterior P and its Sinkhorn class-balanced version Q, total=(1-strength)*log P + strength*log Q, applied in core_math.finalize before typography/native fusion
change.why: Ref A exposes no free logit temperature (gauss-head temperatures are cross-fit; ATLAS prod temperatures come from the bundle). balance_logits strength is the existing scalar that reshapes final class posteriors; lowering it 0.30->0.25 relaxes the train-prior/marginal balancing. Note the provenance line 'sinkhorn_strength': .30 in ensemble.py's execution-contract.json is a hardcoded record and is left unchanged.
